test_title: PYST 12: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 13 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people J, K, L, M, N and O are sitting in a straight row, facing north. O and N are sitting at the extreme ends of the line. There are only three people to the right of K and only three people to the left of J. O is sitting second to the left of K. M is sitting in between J and N. Who is sitting in between O and K ?
solution:
The Pattern follow here is;

**Given: **Six people J, K, L, M, N and O are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) There are only three people to the right of K and only three people to the left of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37c81137b8b7bd611427e26681bcba13fdd604498ba4088ad424642c63afe897.png] 

2) O is sitting second to the left of K. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/816fb1da629ab3cce267942873b4c912c139841448ee1106505b6e1203dee795.png] 

3) M is sitting between J and N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79d42af4a9953677597640b0332fd8f250ca5a6998dd7e4e964bc4d511b359a0.png] 

4) L is sitting on the vacant place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61ee756102dc98f07f5c6d3c9555de8670b706bb7cf380ee99570cd2263f5012.png] 

Clearly, L is sitting between O and K.

Hence, L is the correct answer.
